'''Dagger Flight''' was a subsection of the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], Dagger Flight was led by [[Starks]], and co-winged by [[Dibs]] and [[Rocket (77th Air Wing)|Rocket]] by the time of the initial attempt at infiltrating the shaft leading to the [[Citadel of Axes]]' shields' [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]. After the initial failed attempt at infiltrating the shaft, resulting in the deaths of [[Scimitar Flight]], the second attempt had Dibs and Rocket continuing to operate under Dagger Flight while Starks worked with [[Blade Flight]] in the infiltration attempt, with Dagger Flight also being tasked with holding off Separatist forces above until Blade Flight destroyed the reactor. All members survived the battle.
